After [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] was [[Gran colonization program|colonized]] by the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], a '''conflict''' broke out between the settlers and the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]. Kinyen was forced to spend a massive amount of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] supporting its colony, which allowed the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] to take over control of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. After their ultimate failure, the Gran granted their colonies independence and embraced isolationism.<ref name="Strongholds" />
